Stench.desc: By releasing stench when attacking, this Pokémon may cause the target to flinch.
Stench.accurate: Grants a 10% flinch chance to attacks that normally cannot flinch.

Drizzle.desc: The Pokémon makes it rain when it enters a battle.

Speed Boost.desc: Its Speed stat is boosted every turn.
Speed Boost.accurate: Raises Speed by 1 stage at the end of each full turn on the field.

Battle Armor.desc: Hard armor protects the Pokémon from critical hits.
Battle Armor.accurate: Cannot be hit by critical hits.

Sturdy.desc: It cannot be knocked out with one hit. One-hit KO moves cannot knock it out, either.
Sturdy.accurate: At full HP, survives one hit with at least 1 HP. Immune to OHKO moves.

Damp.desc: Prevents the use of explosive moves such as Self-Destruct by dampening its surroundings.
Damp.accurate: Prevents Explosion, Mind Blown, Misty Explosion, Self-Destruct, and Aftermath while active.

Limber.desc: Its limber body protects the Pokémon from paralysis.
Limber.accurate: Prevents paralysis and cures it if gained while paralyzed.

Sand Veil.desc: Boosts the Pokémon's evasion in a sandstorm.
Sand Veil.accurate: Boosts evasiveness to 1.25x during Sandstorm and prevents Sandstorm damage.

Static.desc: The Pokémon is charged with static electricity, so contact with it may cause paralysis.
Static.accurate: Gives Pokémon making contact a 30% chance to be paralyzed.

Volt Absorb.desc: Restores HP if hit by an Electric-type move, instead of taking damage.
Volt Absorb.accurate: Grants immunity to Electric moves and restores 1/4 max HP when hit by one.

Water Absorb.desc: Restores HP if hit by a Water-type move, instead of taking damage.
Water Absorb.accurate: Grants immunity to Water moves and restores 1/4 max HP when hit by one.

Oblivious.desc: The Pokémon is oblivious, preventing it from becoming infatuated, taunted, or affected by Intimidate.
Oblivious.accurate: Prevents infatuation and Taunt, and grants immunity to Intimidate.

Compound Eyes.desc: The Pokémon's compound eyes boost its accuracy.

Insomnia.desc: The Pokémon is suffering from insomnia and cannot fall asleep.
Insomnia.accurate: Prevents sleep and cures it if gained while asleep.

Color Change.desc: The Pokémon's type becomes the type of the move used on it.
Color Change.accurate: Changes type to the type of a move that hits it, unless it already has that type.

Immunity.desc: The immune system of the Pokémon prevents it from getting poisoned.
Immunity.accurate: Prevents poison and cures it if gained while poisoned.

Flash Fire.desc: Powers up the Pokémon's Fire-type moves if it's hit by one.
Flash Fire.accurate: Grants immunity to Fire moves. After being hit by one, Fire-type attacks deal 1.5x damage.

Shield Dust.desc: This Pokémon's dust blocks the additional effects of attacks taken.
Shield Dust.accurate: Prevents the secondary effects of other Pokémon attacks.

Own Tempo.desc: This Pokémon has its own tempo, preventing it from becoming confused or affected by Intimidate.
Own Tempo.accurate: Prevents confusion. Also grants immunity to Intimidate.

Suction Cups.desc: This Pokémon uses suction cups to stay in one spot to negate all moves and items that force switching out.
Suction Cups.accurate: Prevents being forced out by another Pokémon attack or item.

Intimidate.desc: The Pokémon intimidates opposing Pokémon upon entering battle, lowering their Attack stat.
Intimidate.accurate: Lowers the Attack of opposing Pokémon by 1 stage on switch-in.

Shadow Tag.desc: This Pokémon steps on the opposing Pokémon's shadow to prevent it from escaping.
Shadow Tag.accurate: Prevents opposing Pokémon from choosing to switch out unless they also have this Ability.

Rough Skin.desc: This Pokémon inflicts damage with its rough skin to the attacker on contact.
Rough Skin.accurate: Causes Pokémon making contact to lose 1/8 of their max HP.

Wonder Guard.desc: Its mysterious power only lets supereffective moves hit the Pokémon.
Wonder Guard.accurate: Can only be damaged by supereffective moves and indirect damage.

Levitate.desc: By floating in the air, the Pokémon receives full immunity to all Ground-type moves.
Levitate.accurate: Grants immunity to Ground-type moves. Gravity, Ingrain, Smack Down, and Iron Ball remove this immunity.

Effect Spore.desc: Contact with the Pokémon may inflict poison, sleep, or paralysis on its attacker.
Effect Spore.accurate: Gives Pokémon making contact a 30% chance to be poisoned, paralyzed, or put to sleep.

Synchronize.desc: The attacker will receive the same status condition if it inflicts a burn, poison, or paralysis to the Pokémon.
Synchronize.accurate: Passes burn, poison, or paralysis back to a Pokémon that inflicts it.

Clear Body.desc: Prevents other Pokémon's moves or Abilities from lowering the Pokémon's stats.
Clear Body.accurate: Prevents other Pokémon from lowering stat stages.

Natural Cure.desc: All status conditions heal when the Pokémon switches out.
Natural Cure.accurate: Cures non-volatile status conditions on switch-out.

Lightning Rod.desc: The Pokémon draws in all Electric-type moves. Instead of being hit by Electric-type moves, it boosts its Sp. Atk.
Lightning Rod.accurate: Draws in Electric moves, grants immunity to them, and raises Sp. Atk by 1 stage when hit.

Serene Grace.desc: Boosts the likelihood of additional effects occurring when attacking.
Serene Grace.accurate: Doubles the secondary effect chance of moves.

Swift Swim.desc: Boosts the Pokémon's Speed stat in rain.

Chlorophyll.desc: Boosts the Pokémon's Speed stat in sunshine.

Illuminate.desc: Raises the likelihood of meeting wild Pokémon by illuminating the surroundings.
Illuminate.accurate: Prevents accuracy from being lowered by other Pokémon and ignores their evasiveness.

Trace.desc: When it enters a battle, the Pokémon copies an opposing Pokémon's Ability.
Trace.accurate: Copies the Ability of a random adjacent foe on switch-in, or whenever possible.

Poison Point.desc: Contact with the Pokémon may poison the attacker.
Poison Point.accurate: Gives Pokémon making contact a 30% chance to be poisoned.

Inner Focus.desc: The Pokémon's intense focus protects it from flinching and prevents its Attack stat from being lowered.
Inner Focus.accurate: Prevents flinching and grants immunity to Intimidate.

Magma Armor.desc: The Pokémon is covered with hot magma, which prevents the Pokémon from becoming frozen.
Magma Armor.accurate: Prevents freezing and cures it if gained while frozen.

Water Veil.desc: The Pokémon is covered with a water veil, which prevents the Pokémon from getting a burn.
Water Veil.accurate: Prevents burns and cures them if gained while burned.

Magnet Pull.desc: Prevents Steel-type Pokémon from escaping using its magnetic force.
Magnet Pull.accurate: Prevents opposing Steel-type Pokémon from choosing to switch out. Does not work on Ghost-type Pokémon.

Soundproof.desc: Soundproofing of the Pokémon itself gives full immunity to all sound-based moves.
Soundproof.accurate: Grants immunity to sound-based moves unless it used the move.

Rain Dish.desc: The Pokémon gradually regains HP in rain.
Rain Dish.accurate: Restores 1/16 of max HP each turn during Rain Dance.

Sand Stream.desc: The Pokémon summons a sandstorm when it enters a battle.

Pressure.desc: By putting pressure on the opposing Pokémon, it raises their PP usage.
Pressure.accurate: Causes opposing moves targeting it to lose 1 extra PP.

Thick Fat.desc: The Pokémon is protected by a layer of thick fat, which halves the damage taken from Fire- and Ice-type moves.
Thick Fat.accurate: Causes Fire- and Ice-type moves to use half their usual offensive stat against it.

Early Bird.desc: The Pokémon awakens twice as fast as other Pokémon from sleep.
Early Bird.accurate: Causes the sleep counter to decrease by 2 instead of 1.

Flame Body.desc: Contact with the Pokémon may burn the attacker.
Flame Body.accurate: Gives Pokémon making contact a 30% chance to be burned.

Run Away.desc: Enables a sure getaway from wild Pokémon.
Run Away.accurate: Guarantees to flee from any wild battle.

Keen Eye.desc: Keen eyes prevent other Pokémon from lowering this Pokémon's accuracy.
Keen Eye.accurate: Prevents accuracy from being lowered by other Pokémon and ignores their evasiveness.

Hyper Cutter.desc: The Pokémon's proud of its powerful pincers. They prevent other Pokémon from lowering its Attack stat.
Hyper Cutter.accurate: Prevents other Pokémon from lowering Attack.

Pickup.desc: The Pokémon may pick up the item an opposing Pokémon used during a battle. It may pick up items outside of battle, too.
Pickup.accurate: Lets it pick up an item used by an adjacent Pokémon this turn if it is not already holding one.

Truant.desc: The Pokémon cannot use a move the following turn if it uses one.
Truant.accurate: Causes it to skip every other turn instead of using a move.

Hustle.desc: Boosts the Attack stat, but lowers accuracy.
Hustle.accurate: Boosts Attack to 1.5x, but lowers the accuracy of physical attacks to 0.8x.

Cute Charm.desc: Contact with the Pokémon may cause infatuation.
Cute Charm.accurate: Gives opposite-gender Pokémon making contact a 30% chance to become infatuated.

Plus.desc: Boosts the Sp. Atk stat of the Pokémon if an ally with the Plus or Minus Ability is also in battle.
Plus.accurate: Boosts Sp. Atk to 1.5x if an active ally has this Ability or Minus.

Minus.desc: Boosts the Sp. Atk stat of the Pokémon if an ally with the Plus or Minus Ability is also in battle.
Minus.accurate: Boosts Sp. Atk to 1.5x if an active ally has this Ability or Plus.

Forecast.desc: The Pokémon transforms with the weather to change its type to Water, Fire, or Ice.
Forecast.accurate: Changes Castform type to match the current weather, except during Sandstorm.

Sticky Hold.desc: Items held by the Pokémon are stuck fast and cannot be removed by other Pokémon.
Sticky Hold.accurate: Prevents loss of the held item due to another Pokémon Ability or attack.

Shed Skin.desc: The Pokémon may heal its own status conditions by shedding its skin.
Shed Skin.accurate: Gives a 33% chance to cure status at the end of each turn.

Guts.desc: It's so gutsy that having a status condition boosts the Pokémon's Attack stat.
Guts.accurate: Boosts Attack to 1.5x while statused and ignores the burn penalty to physical damage.

Marvel Scale.desc: The Pokémon's marvelous scales boost the Defense stat if it has a status condition.
Marvel Scale.accurate: Boosts Defense to 1.5x while affected by a non-volatile status condition.

Liquid Ooze.desc: Oozed liquid has strong stench, which damages attackers using any draining move.
Liquid Ooze.accurate: Damages Pokémon draining HP from it by the amount they would have recovered.

Overgrow.desc: Powers up Grass-type moves when the Pokémon's HP is low.
Overgrow.accurate: Boosts the offensive stat used for Grass-type attacks to 1.5x at 1/3 max HP or less.

Blaze.desc: Powers up Fire-type moves when the Pokémon's HP is low.
Blaze.accurate: Boosts the offensive stat used for Fire-type attacks to 1.5x at 1/3 max HP or less.

Torrent.desc: Powers up Water-type moves when the Pokémon's HP is low.
Torrent.accurate: Boosts the offensive stat used for Water-type attacks to 1.5x at 1/3 max HP or less.

Swarm.desc: Powers up Bug-type moves when the Pokémon's HP is low.
Swarm.accurate: Boosts the offensive stat used for Bug-type attacks to 1.5x at 1/3 max HP or less.

Rock Head.desc: Protects the Pokémon from recoil damage.
Rock Head.accurate: Prevents recoil damage except from Struggle, Life Orb, or crash damage.

Drought.desc: Turns the sunlight harsh when the Pokémon enters a battle.

Arena Trap.accurate: Prevents opposing Pokémon from choosing to switch out unless they are airborne.

Vital Spirit.desc: The Pokémon is full of vitality, and that prevents it from falling asleep.
Vital Spirit.accurate: Prevents sleep and cures it if gained while asleep.

White Smoke.desc: The Pokémon is protected by its white smoke, which prevents other Pokémon from lowering its stats.
White Smoke.accurate: Prevents other Pokémon from lowering stat stages.

Pure Power.desc: Using its pure power, the Pokémon doubles its Attack stat.

Shell Armor.desc: A hard shell protects the Pokémon from critical hits.

Tangled Feet.desc: Raises evasion if the Pokémon is confused.

Motor Drive.desc: Boosts its Speed stat if hit by an Electric-type move, instead of taking damage.
Motor Drive.accurate: Raises Speed by 1 stage when hit by an Electric move and grants immunity to Electric moves.

Rivalry.desc: Becomes competitive and deals more damage to Pokémon of the same gender, but deals less to Pokémon of the opposite gender.
Rivalry.accurate: Boosts damage to 1.25x against targets of the same gender and lowers it to 0.75x against targets of the opposite gender.

Steadfast.desc: The Pokémon's determination boosts the Speed stat each time the Pokémon flinches.
Steadfast.accurate: Raises Speed by 1 stage after flinching.

Snow Cloak.desc: Boosts evasion in a hailstorm or snow.

Gluttony.desc: Makes the Pokémon eat a held Berry when its HP drops to half or less, which is sooner than usual.
Gluttony.accurate: Causes Berries to be eaten at 1/2 max HP or less instead of the usual 1/4 max HP.

Anger Point.desc: The Pokémon is angered when it takes a critical hit, and that maxes its Attack stat.
Anger Point.accurate: Raises Attack by 12 stages when hit by a critical hit, provided the hit does not strike a substitute.

Unburden.desc: Boosts the Speed stat if the Pokémon's held item is used or lost.
Unburden.accurate: Doubles Speed after losing the held item. This boost ends if it switches out or gains a new item or Ability.

Heatproof.desc: The heatproof body of the Pokémon halves the damage from Fire-type moves that hit it.
Heatproof.accurate: Causes Fire damage to use half the usual offensive stat against it and halves burn damage.

Simple.desc: The stat changes the Pokémon receives are doubled.

Dry Skin.desc: Restores HP in rain or when hit by Water-type moves. Reduces HP in sunshine, and increases the damage received from Fire-type moves.
Dry Skin.accurate: Restores 1/4 max HP from Water moves and 1/8 each turn in Rain, but takes 1.25x damage from Fire moves and loses 1/8 each turn in Sun.

Download.desc: Compares an opposing Pokémon's Defense and Sp. Def stats before raising its own Attack or Sp. Atk stat, whichever will be more effective.
Download.accurate: Raises Attack or Sp. Atk by 1 stage on switch-in based on the foes weaker defensive stat.

Iron Fist.accurate: Boosts punch-based attacks to 1.2x power. Sucker Punch is not boosted.

Poison Heal.desc: Restores HP if the Pokémon is poisoned, instead of losing HP.
Poison Heal.accurate: Restores 1/8 of max HP each turn while poisoned instead of losing HP.

Adaptability.desc: Powers up moves of the same type as the Pokémon.
Adaptability.accurate: Raises same-type attack bonus (STAB) to 2x instead of 1.5x.

Skill Link.desc: Maximizes the number of times multi-strike moves hit.
Skill Link.accurate: Causes multi-hit moves to always hit the maximum number of times.

Hydration.desc: Heals status conditions if it's raining.
Hydration.accurate: Cures status at the end of each turn during Rain Dance.

Solar Power.desc: Boosts the Sp. Atk stat in sunny weather, but HP decreases every turn.
Solar Power.accurate: Boosts Sp. Atk to 1.5x during Sunny Day, but causes the loss of 1/8 max HP each turn.

Quick Feet.desc: Boosts the Speed stat if the Pokémon has a status condition.
Quick Feet.accurate: Boosts Speed to 1.5x while statused and ignores the Speed drop from paralysis.

Normalize.desc: All the Pokémon's moves become Normal type. The power of those moves is boosted a little.
Normalize.accurate: Changes all moves to Normal type and boosts their power to 1.2x.

Sniper.desc: Powers up moves if they become critical hits when attacking.

Magic Guard.desc: The Pokémon only takes damage from attacks.
Magic Guard.accurate: Takes damage only from direct attacks.

No Guard.desc: The Pokémon employs no-guard tactics to ensure incoming and outgoing attacks always land.
No Guard.accurate: Causes all moves used by or against it to always hit.

Stall.desc: The Pokémon moves after all other Pokémon do.
Stall.accurate: Causes it to move last among Pokémon using moves of the same or higher priority.

Technician.desc: Powers up the Pokémon's weaker moves.
Technician.accurate: Boosts moves with 60 power or less to 1.5x power, including Struggle.

Leaf Guard.desc: Prevents status conditions in sunny weather.
Leaf Guard.accurate: Prevents status conditions during Sunny Day and causes Rest to fail.

Klutz.desc: The Pokémon cannot use any held items.
Klutz.accurate: Prevents the held item from having an effect, except Macho Brace, and blocks the use of Fling.

Mold Breaker.desc: Moves can be used on the target regardless of its Abilities.
Mold Breaker.accurate: Causes moves and their effects to ignore the Abilities of other Pokémon.

Super Luck.desc: The Pokémon is so lucky that the critical-hit ratios of its moves are boosted.
Super Luck.accurate: Raises the critical hit ratio by 1 stage.

Aftermath.desc: Damages the attacker if it contacts the Pokémon with a finishing hit.
Aftermath.accurate: Causes a Pokémon that KOs it with a contact move to lose 1/4 of its max HP.

Anticipation.desc: The Pokémon can sense an opposing Pokémon's dangerous moves.
Anticipation.accurate: Causes it to shudder on switch-in if a foe has a supereffective move or an OHKO move.

Forewarn.desc: When it enters a battle, the Pokémon can tell one of the moves an opposing Pokémon has.
Forewarn.accurate: Reveals the foes move with the highest power on switch-in.

Unaware.desc: When attacking, the Pokémon ignores the target Pokémon's stat changes.
Unaware.accurate: Ignores the stat stages of other Pokémon when dealing or taking damage.

Tinted Lens.desc: The Pokémon can use 'not very effective' moves to deal regular damage.
Tinted Lens.accurate: Doubles damage from attacks that would otherwise be not very effective.

Filter.desc: Reduces the power of supereffective attacks taken.
Filter.accurate: Reduces damage from supereffective attacks to 3/4.

Slow Start.desc: For five turns, the Pokémon's Attack and Speed stats are halved.
Slow Start.accurate: Halves Attack and Speed for 5 turns after switch-in.

Scrappy.desc: The Pokémon can hit Ghost-type Pokémon with Normal- and Fighting-type moves. It also makes the Pokémon immune to Intimidate.
Scrappy.accurate: Fighting- and Normal-type moves hit Ghost-type targets and grants immunity to Intimidate.

Storm Drain.desc: Draws in all Water-type moves. Instead of being hit by Water-type moves, it boosts its Sp. Atk.
Storm Drain.accurate: Draws in Water moves, grants immunity to them, and raises Sp. Atk by 1 stage when hit.

Ice Body.desc: The Pokémon gradually regains HP in a hailstorm or snow.
Ice Body.accurate: Restores 1/16 of max HP each turn during Snow.

Solid Rock.desc: Reduces the power of supereffective attacks taken.
Solid Rock.accurate: Reduces damage from supereffective attacks to 3/4.

Snow Warning.desc: The Pokémon summons a snowstorm when it enters a battle, which boosts the Defense of Ice-type Pokémon by 50% and deals no damage.

Honey Gather.desc: The Pokémon may gather Honey after a battle.
Honey Gather.accurate: May collect Honey after a battle is won if not already holding an item, even without participating in battle.

Frisk.desc: When it enters a battle, the Pokémon can check an opposing Pokémon's held item.
Frisk.accurate: Reveals the held items of all opposing Pokémon on switch-in.

Reckless.desc: Powers up moves that have recoil damage.
Reckless.accurate: Boosts moves with recoil or crash damage to 1.2x power, except Struggle.

Multitype.desc: Changes the Pokémon's type to match the Plate or Z-Crystal it holds.
Multitype.accurate: Changes Arceus type to match its held Plate.

Flower Gift.desc: Boosts the Attack and Sp. Def stats of itself and allies when it is sunny.
Flower Gift.accurate: If the user is Cherrim and Sunny Day is active, boosts its Attack and Sp. Def and those of its allies to 1.5x.

Bad Dreams.desc: Reduces the HP of sleeping opposing Pokémon.
Bad Dreams.accurate: Causes sleeping foes to lose 1/8 of their max HP at the end of each turn.

Pickpocket.desc: Steals an item from an attacker that made direct contact.
Pickpocket.accurate: Steals the attackers item when hit by a contact move while not holding an item.

Sheer Force.desc: Removes additional effects to increase the power of moves when attacking.
Sheer Force.accurate: Boosts attacks with secondary effects to 1.3x power, but removes those effects.

Contrary.desc: Makes stat changes have an opposite effect.

Unnerve.desc: Unnerves opposing Pokémon and makes them unable to eat Berries.
Unnerve.accurate: Prevents opposing Pokémon from using their Berries while active.

Defiant.desc: Boosts the Pokémon's Attack stat sharply when its stats are lowered.
Defiant.accurate: Raises Attack by 2 stages whenever a foe lowers one of its stats.

Defeatist.desc: Halves the Pokémon's Attack and Sp. Atk stats when its HP becomes half or less.
Defeatist.accurate: Halves Attack and Sp. Atk at 1/2 max HP or less.

Cursed Body.desc: May disable a move used on the Pokémon.
Cursed Body.accurate: Gives attacks that hit it a 30% chance to become disabled.

Healer.desc: Sometimes heals an ally's status condition.
Healer.accurate: Gives an ally a 30% chance to have its status cured at the end of each turn.

Friend Guard.accurate: Reduces damage taken by allies from other Pokémon attacks to 3/4.

Weak Armor.desc: Physical attacks to the Pokémon lower its Defense stat but sharply raise its Speed stat.
Weak Armor.accurate: Lowers Defense by 1 stage and raises Speed by 2 stages when hit by a physical attack.

Multiscale.desc: Reduces the amount of damage the Pokémon takes when its HP is full.
Multiscale.accurate: Halves damage from attacks while at full HP.

Toxic Boost.desc: Powers up physical attacks when the Pokémon is poisoned.
Toxic Boost.accurate: Boosts physical attacks to 1.5x power while poisoned.

Flare Boost.desc: Powers up special attacks when the Pokémon is burned.
Flare Boost.accurate: Boosts special attacks to 1.5x power while burned.

Harvest.desc: May create another Berry after one is used.
Harvest.accurate: Gives a 50% chance to restore a Berry used previously at the end of each turn, or 100% in Sun.

Telepathy.desc: Anticipates an ally's attack and dodges it.
Telepathy.accurate: Prevents damage from attacks made by allies.

Moody.desc: At the end of each turn, raises one of the Pokémon's stats by two stages and lowers another stat by one stage, excluding Accuracy and Evasion.
Moody.accurate: Raises one random stat except accuracy or evasion by 2 stages and lowers another by 1 stage at the end of each turn.

Overcoat.desc: Protects the Pokémon from things like sand, hail, and powder.
Overcoat.accurate: Grants immunity to powder moves, Sandstorm damage, and Effect Spore.

Poison Touch.desc: May poison a target when the Pokémon makes contact.
Poison Touch.accurate: Gives contact moves a 30% chance to poison.

Regenerator.desc: Restores a little HP when withdrawn from battle.
Regenerator.accurate: Restores 1/3 of maximum HP, rounded down, on switch-out.

Big Pecks.desc: Protects the Pokémon from Defense-lowering effects.
Big Pecks.accurate: Prevents other Pokémon from lowering Defense.

Sand Rush.desc: Boosts the Pokémon's Speed stat in a sandstorm.
Sand Rush.accurate: Doubles Speed during Sandstorm and prevents Sandstorm damage.

Wonder Skin.desc: Makes status moves more likely to miss.
Wonder Skin.accurate: Lowers the accuracy of status moves that check accuracy to 50% when targeting it.

Analytic.desc: Boosts move power when the Pokémon moves last.
Analytic.accurate: Boosts attacks to 1.3x power if it moves last in the turn.

Illusion.desc: Comes out disguised as the Pokémon in the party's last spot.
Illusion.accurate: Makes it appear as the last Pokémon in the party until it takes direct damage.

Imposter.desc: The Pokémon transforms itself into the Pokémon it's facing.
Imposter.accurate: Transforms into the opposing Pokémon facing it on switch-in.

Infiltrator.desc: Passes through the opposing Pokémon's barrier, substitute, and the like and strikes.
Infiltrator.accurate: Moves ignore foes Substitute, Reflect, Light Screen, Safeguard, Mist, and Aurora Veil.

Mummy.desc: Contact with the Pokémon changes the attacker's Ability to Mummy.
Mummy.accurate: Changes the Ability of Pokémon making contact to Mummy.

Moxie.desc: The Pokémon shows moxie, and that boosts the Attack stat after knocking out any Pokémon.
Moxie.accurate: Raises Attack by 1 stage after attacking and KOing another Pokémon.

Justified.desc: Being hit by a Dark-type move boosts the Attack stat of the Pokémon, for justice.
Justified.accurate: Raises Attack by 1 stage after taking damage from a Dark-type move.

Rattled.desc: When the Pokémon is hit by a Dark-, Ghost-, or Bug-type move, its Speed stat is raised by one stage. Being intimidated also raises its Speed stat by one stage.
Rattled.accurate: Raises Speed by 1 stage when hit by a Bug-, Dark-, or Ghost-type attack, or when affected by Intimidate.

Magic Bounce.desc: Reflects status moves, instead of getting hit by them.
Magic Bounce.accurate: Blocks certain status moves and bounces them back to the user.

Sap Sipper.desc: Boosts the Attack stat if hit by a Grass-type move, instead of taking damage.
Sap Sipper.accurate: Grants immunity to Grass moves and raises Attack by 1 stage when hit by one.

Prankster.desc: Gives priority to a status move.
Prankster.accurate: Raises the priority of status moves by 1, but Dark-type targets are immune.

Sand Force.desc: Boosts the power of Rock-, Ground-, and Steel-type moves in a sandstorm.
Sand Force.accurate: Boosts Ground-, Rock-, and Steel-type attacks to 1.3x during Sandstorm and prevents Sandstorm damage.

Iron Barbs.desc: Inflicts damage to the attacker on contact with iron barbs.
Iron Barbs.accurate: Causes Pokémon making contact to lose 1/8 of their max HP.

Zen Mode.desc: Changes the Pokémon's shape when HP is half or less.
Zen Mode.accurate: If the user is Darmanitan, changes to Standard Mode at the end of the turn if above 1/2 max HP; otherwise changes to Zen Mode.

Victory Star.desc: Boosts the accuracy of its allies and itself.
Victory Star.accurate: Boosts the accuracy of this Pokémon and its allies moves to 1.1x.

Turboblaze.desc: Moves can be used on the target regardless of its Abilities.
Turboblaze.accurate: Causes moves and their effects to ignore the Abilities of other Pokémon.

Teravolt.desc: Moves can be used on the target regardless of its Abilities.
Teravolt.accurate: Causes moves and their effects to ignore the Abilities of other Pokémon.

Aroma Veil.desc: Protects itself and its allies from attacks that limit their move choices.
Aroma Veil.accurate: Protects the user and its allies from Attract, Disable, Encore, Heal Block, Taunt, and Torment.

Flower Veil.desc: Ally Grass-type Pokémon are protected from status conditions and the lowering of their stats.
Flower Veil.accurate: Prevents Grass-type allies on this side from having their stats lowered or being statused by other Pokémon.

Cheek Pouch.desc: Restores HP as well when the Pokémon eats a Berry.
Cheek Pouch.accurate: Restores 1/3 of max HP after eating a Berry, in addition to the Berrys usual effect.

Protean.desc: Changes the Pokémon's type to the type of the move it's about to use, but only once per switch-in.
Protean.accurate: Changes type to match the move being used. Activates once per switch-in.

Fur Coat.desc: Halves the damage from physical moves.

Magician.desc: The Pokémon steals the held item of a Pokémon it hits with a move.
Magician.accurate: Steals the item of a Pokémon hit by an attack while not holding an item.

Bulletproof.desc: Protects the Pokémon from some ball and bomb moves.

Competitive.desc: Boosts the Sp. Atk stat sharply when a stat is lowered.
Competitive.accurate: Raises Sp. Atk by 2 stages whenever a foe lowers one of its stats.

Strong Jaw.desc: The Pokémon's strong jaw boosts the power of its biting moves.
Strong Jaw.accurate: Boosts bite-based attacks to 1.5x power. Bug Bite is not boosted.

Refrigerate.desc: Normal-type moves become Ice-type moves. The power of those moves is boosted a little.
Refrigerate.accurate: Changes Normal-type moves to Ice type and boosts their power to 1.2x.

Sweet Veil.desc: Prevents itself and ally Pokémon from falling asleep.
Sweet Veil.accurate: Prevents sleep for the user and its allies. Pokémon already asleep do not wake up from this effect.

Stance Change.desc: The Pokémon changes its form to Blade Forme when it uses an attack move, and changes to Shield Forme when it uses King's Shield.
Stance Change.accurate: If the user is Aegislash, changes to Blade Forme before attacking and to Shield Forme before using King's Shield.

Gale Wings.desc: Gives priority to Flying-type moves when the Pokémon's HP is full.
Gale Wings.accurate: Raises the priority of Flying-type moves by 1 while at full HP.

Mega Launcher.desc: Powers up aura and pulse moves.
Mega Launcher.accurate: Boosts pulse moves to 1.5x power. Heal Pulse restores 3/4 of the targets max HP.

Grass Pelt.desc: Boosts the Pokémon's Defense stat in Grassy Terrain.
Grass Pelt.accurate: Boosts Defense to 1.5x while Grassy Terrain is active.

Symbiosis.desc: The Pokémon passes its item to an ally that has used up an item.
Symbiosis.accurate: Passes its held item to an ally immediately after that ally uses its item.

Tough Claws.desc: Powers up moves that make direct contact.

Pixilate.desc: Normal-type moves become Fairy-type moves. The power of those moves is boosted a little.
Pixilate.accurate: Changes Normal-type moves to Fairy type and boosts their power to 1.2x.

Gooey.desc: Contact with the Pokémon lowers the attacker's Speed stat.
Gooey.accurate: Lowers the Speed of Pokémon making contact by 1 stage.

Aerilate.desc: Normal-type moves become Flying-type moves. The power of those moves is boosted a little.
Aerilate.accurate: Changes Normal-type moves to Flying type and boosts their power to 1.2x.

Parental Bond.accurate: Causes damaging moves to hit twice. The second hit deals one-quarter damage.

Dark Aura.desc: Powers up each Pokémon's Dark-type moves.
Dark Aura.accurate: While active, boosts the power of Dark-type moves used by any Pokémon to 1.33x.

Fairy Aura.desc: Powers up each Pokémon's Fairy-type moves.
Fairy Aura.accurate: While active, boosts the power of Fairy-type moves used by any Pokémon to 1.33x.

Aura Break.desc: The effects of 'Aura' Abilities are reversed to lower the power of affected moves.
Aura Break.accurate: While active, changes the Dark Aura and Fairy Aura power modifier to 0.75x.

Primordial Sea.desc: The Pokémon changes the weather to nullify Fire-type attacks.
Primordial Sea.accurate: Starts heavy rain on switch-in. The effect lasts until this Ability is no longer active in battle.

Desolate Land.desc: The Pokémon changes the weather to nullify Water-type attacks.
Desolate Land.accurate: Starts extremely harsh sunlight on switch-in. The effect lasts until this Ability is no longer active in battle.

Delta Stream.desc: The Pokémon changes the weather to eliminate all of the Flying type's weaknesses.
Delta Stream.accurate: Starts strong winds on switch-in. The effect lasts until this Ability is no longer active in battle.

Stamina.desc: Boosts the Defense stat when hit by an attack.
Stamina.accurate: Raises Defense by 1 stage after taking damage from a move.

Wimp Out.desc: The Pokémon cowardly switches out when its HP becomes half or less.
Wimp Out.accurate: Forces a switch when HP drops to 1/2 or less of maximum HP.

Emergency Exit.desc: The Pokémon, sensing danger, switches out when its HP becomes half or less.
Emergency Exit.accurate: Forces a switch when HP drops to 1/2 or less of maximum HP.

Water Compaction.desc: Boosts the Pokémon's Defense stat sharply when hit by a Water-type move.
Water Compaction.accurate: Raises Defense by 2 stages after taking damage from a Water-type move.

Merciless.desc: The Pokémon's attacks become critical hits if the target is poisoned.
Merciless.accurate: Makes attacks always land as critical hits against poisoned targets.

Shields Down.desc: When its HP becomes half or less, the Pokémon's shell breaks and it becomes aggressive.
Shields Down.accurate: If the user is Minior, changes to Core Form at 1/2 max HP or less on switch-in or at the end of the turn; otherwise changes to Meteor Form.

Stakeout.desc: Doubles the damage dealt to the target's replacement if the target switches out.
Stakeout.accurate: Doubles the offensive stat used against a target that switched in this turn.

Water Bubble.desc: Lowers the power of Fire-type moves done to the Pokémon and prevents the Pokémon from getting a burn.
Water Bubble.accurate: Doubles Water-type power, prevents burns, and halves the power of Fire-type attacks used against it.

Steelworker.accurate: Boosts the offensive stat used for Steel-type attacks to 1.5x.

Berserk.desc: Boosts the Pokémon's Sp. Atk stat when it takes a hit that causes its HP to become half or less.
Berserk.accurate: Raises Sp. Atk by 1 stage when HP drops to 1/2 or less of max HP.

Slush Rush.desc: Boosts the Pokémon's Speed stat in a hailstorm or snow.

Long Reach.desc: The Pokémon uses its moves without making contact with the target.
Long Reach.accurate: Prevents attacks from making contact with the target.

Liquid Voice.desc: All sound-based moves become Water-type moves.
Liquid Voice.accurate: Changes sound-based moves to Water type.

Triage.desc: Gives priority to a healing move.
Triage.accurate: Raises the priority of healing moves by 3.

Galvanize.desc: Normal-type moves become Electric-type moves. The power of those moves is boosted a little.
Galvanize.accurate: Changes Normal-type moves to Electric type and boosts their power to 1.2x.

Surge Surfer.desc: Doubles the Pokémon's Speed stat on Electric Terrain.
Surge Surfer.accurate: Doubles Speed while Electric Terrain is active.

Schooling.desc: When it has a lot of HP, the Pokémon forms a powerful school. It stops schooling when its HP is low.
Schooling.accurate: If the user is Wishiwashi, changes to School Form above 1/4 max HP; otherwise changes to Solo Form.

Disguise.desc: Once per battle, the shroud that covers the Pokémon can protect it from an attack. If Disguise is broken, the Pokémon takes 1/8 of its maximum HP as damage.
Disguise.accurate: Mimikyu only. Blocks the first hit taken and causes 1/8 max HP recoil instead.

Battle Bond.desc: Defeating an opposing Pokémon strengthens the Pokémon's bond with its Trainer, and it becomes Ash-Greninja. Water Shuriken gets more powerful.
Battle Bond.accurate: After KOing a Pokémon, raises Attack, Sp. Atk, and Speed by 1 stage. Activates once per battle.

Power Construct.desc: Other Cells gather to aid when its HP becomes half or less. Then the Pokémon changes its form to Complete Forme.
Power Construct.accurate: If the user is Zygarde 10% Forme or 50% Forme, changes to Complete Forme at the end of the turn when at 1/2 max HP or less.

Corrosion.desc: The Pokémon can poison the target even if it's a Steel or Poison type.
Corrosion.accurate: Poison and bad poison affect Pokémon regardless of typing.

Comatose.desc: It's always drowsing and will never wake up. It can attack without waking up.
Comatose.accurate: Prevents status conditions and makes the user count as asleep.

Queenly Majesty.desc: Its majesty pressures the opposing Pokémon, making it unable to attack using priority moves.
Queenly Majesty.accurate: Protects the user and its allies from opposing priority moves.

Innards Out.desc: Damages the attacker landing the finishing hit by the amount equal to its last HP.
Innards Out.accurate: If KOed by a move, causes the attacker to lose HP equal to the users remaining HP before the hit.

Dancer.desc: When another Pokémon uses a dance move, it can use a dance move following it regardless of its Speed.
Dancer.accurate: After another Pokémon uses a dance move, uses the same move.

Battery.desc: Powers up ally Pokémon's special moves.
Battery.accurate: Boosts the power of allies special attacks to 1.3x.

Fluffy.desc: Halves the damage taken from moves that make direct contact, but doubles that of Fire-type moves.
Fluffy.accurate: Halves damage from contact moves, but doubles damage from Fire-type moves.

Dazzling.desc: Surprises the opposing Pokémon, making it unable to attack using priority moves.
Dazzling.accurate: Protects the user and its allies from opposing priority moves.

Soul-Heart.desc: Boosts its Sp. Atk stat every time a Pokémon faints.
Soul-Heart.accurate: Raises Sp. Atk by 1 stage whenever another Pokémon faints.

Tangling Hair.desc: Contact with the Pokémon lowers the attacker's Speed stat.
Tangling Hair.accurate: Lowers the Speed of Pokémon making contact by 1 stage.

Receiver.desc: The Pokémon copies the Ability of a defeated ally.
Receiver.accurate: Copies the Ability of a fainted ally.

Power of Alchemy.desc: The Pokémon copies the Ability of a defeated ally.
Power of Alchemy.accurate: Copies the Ability of a fainted ally.

Beast Boost.desc: The Pokémon boosts its most proficient stat each time it knocks out a Pokémon.
Beast Boost.accurate: Raises the highest stat by 1 stage after attacking and KOing another Pokémon.

RKS System.desc: Changes the Pokémon's type to match the memory disc it holds.
RKS System.accurate: If the user is Silvally, changes its type to match its held Memory.

Electric Surge.desc: Turns the ground into Electric Terrain when the Pokémon enters a battle.

Psychic Surge.desc: Turns the ground into Psychic Terrain when the Pokémon enters a battle.

Misty Surge.desc: Turns the ground into Misty Terrain when the Pokémon enters a battle.

Grassy Surge.desc: Turns the ground into Grassy Terrain when the Pokémon enters a battle.

Full Metal Body.desc: Prevents other Pokémon's moves or Abilities from lowering the Pokémon's stats.
Full Metal Body.accurate: Prevents other Pokémon from lowering stat stages.

Shadow Shield.desc: Reduces the amount of damage the Pokémon takes while its HP is full.
Shadow Shield.accurate: Halves damage from attacks while at full HP.

Prism Armor.desc: Reduces the power of super effective attacks taken.
Prism Armor.accurate: Reduces damage from supereffective attacks to 3/4.

Neuroforce.desc: Powers up moves that are super effective.
Neuroforce.accurate: Boosts damage from supereffective attacks to 1.25x.

Cotton Down.desc: When the Pokémon is hit by an attack, it scatters cotton fluff around and lowers the Speed stat of all Pokémon except itself.
Cotton Down.accurate: When hit, lowers the Speed of all other Pokémon on the field by 1 stage.

Ball Fetch.desc: If the Pokémon is not holding an item, it will fetch the Poké Ball from the first failed throw of the battle.
Ball Fetch.accurate: After the first Pokéball thrown fails to catch a Pokémon, picks up that same type of Ball at the end of a turn while on the field and not holding an item. Activates once per battle.

Steam Engine.desc: Boosts the Pokémon's Speed stat drastically if hit by a Fire- or Water-type move.
Steam Engine.accurate: Raises Speed by 6 stages after taking damage from a Fire- or Water-type move.

Ripen.desc: Ripens Berries and doubles their effect.
Ripen.accurate: Doubles the effects of certain Berries when eaten.

Sand Spit.desc: The Pokémon creates a sandstorm when it's hit by an attack.
Sand Spit.accurate: Starts Sandstorm after being hit by an attack.

Gulp Missile.desc: When the Pokémon uses Surf or Dive, it will come back with prey. When it takes damage, it will spit out the prey to attack.
Gulp Missile.accurate: After using Surf or Dive, being hit causes the attacker to lose 1/4 max HP and either lose 1 Defense stage or become paralyzed.

Punk Rock.desc: Boosts the power of sound-based moves. The Pokémon also takes half the damage from these kinds of moves.
Punk Rock.accurate: Halves damage taken from sound-based moves and boosts the power of its own sound-based moves to 1.3x.

Wandering Spirit.desc: The Pokémon exchanges Abilities with a Pokémon that hits it with a move that makes direct contact.
Wandering Spirit.accurate: Swaps Abilities with Pokémon making contact.

Power Spot.desc: Just being next to the Pokémon powers up moves.
Power Spot.accurate: Boosts the power of allies moves to 1.3x.

Ice Face.desc: The Pokémon's ice head can take a physical attack as a substitute, but the attack also changes the Pokémon's appearance. The ice will be restored when it hails.
Ice Face.accurate: If the user is Eiscue, the first physical hit it takes deals no damage. The effect is restored during Snow.

Hunger Switch.desc: The Pokémon changes its form, alternating between its Full Belly Mode and Hangry Mode after the end of each turn.
Hunger Switch.accurate: If the user is Morpeko, changes between Full Belly Mode and Hangry Mode at the end of each turn.

Intrepid Sword.desc: Boosts the Pokémon's Attack stat when the Pokémon enters a battle.
Intrepid Sword.accurate: Raises Attack by 1 stage on switch-in. Activates once per battle.

Dauntless Shield.desc: Boosts the Pokémon's Defense stat when the Pokémon enters a battle.
Dauntless Shield.accurate: Raises Defense by 1 stage on switch-in. Activates once per battle.

Gorilla Tactics.desc: Boosts the Pokémon's Attack stat but only allows the use of the first selected move.
Gorilla Tactics.accurate: Boosts Attack to 1.5x, but locks move selection to the first move used.

Mimicry.desc: Changes the Pokémon's type depending on the terrain.
Mimicry.accurate: Changes types to match the current Terrain. The original type returns when the Terrain ends.

Screen Cleaner.desc: When the Pokémon enters a battle, the effects of Light Screen, Reflect, and Aurora Veil are nullified for both opposing and ally Pokémon.
Screen Cleaner.accurate: Ends the effects of Aurora Veil, Light Screen, and Reflect for both sides on switch-in.

Pastel Veil.desc: Protects the Pokémon and its ally Pokémon from being poisoned.
Pastel Veil.accurate: Prevents poison for the user and its allies. Also cures poisoned allies on switch-in.

Neutralizing Gas.desc: If the Pokémon with Neutralizing Gas is in the battle, the effects of all Pokémon's Abilities will be nullified or will not be triggered.
Neutralizing Gas.accurate: While active, suppresses the effects of Abilities.

Libero.desc: Changes the Pokémon's type to the type of the move it's about to use, but only once per switch-in.
Libero.accurate: Changes type to match the move being used. Activates once per switch-in.

Mirror Armor.desc: Bounces back only the stat-lowering effects that the Pokémon receives.
Mirror Armor.accurate: Reflects stat stage drops back to the attacker instead of applying them.

Propeller Tail.desc: Ignores the effects of opposing Pokémon's Abilities and moves that draw in moves.
Propeller Tail.accurate: Prevents moves from being redirected to a different target by any effect.

Steely Spirit.desc: Powers up ally Pokémon's Steel-type moves.
Steely Spirit.accurate: Boosts the power of Steel-type moves used by the user and its allies to 1.5x.

Perish Body.desc: When hit by a move that makes direct contact, the Pokémon and the attacker will faint after three turns unless they switch out of battle.
Perish Body.accurate: Making contact starts the Perish Song effect for both the user and the attacker.

Ice Scales.desc: The Pokémon is protected by ice scales, which halve the damage taken from special moves.
Ice Scales.accurate: Halves damage taken from special attacks.

Stalwart.desc: Ignores the effects of opposing Pokémon's Abilities and moves that draw in moves.
Stalwart.accurate: Prevents moves from being redirected to a different target by any effect.

Unseen Fist.desc: The Pokémon can deal damage with moves that make physical contact, even if the target is protected.
Unseen Fist.accurate: Contact moves ignore the targets protection, except Max Guard.

Quick Draw.desc: Enables the Pokémon to move first occasionally.
Quick Draw.accurate: Gives attacking moves a 30% chance to move first within their priority bracket.

Transistor.desc: Powers up the Pokémon's Electric-type moves.
Transistor.accurate: Boosts the offensive stat used for Electric-type attacks to 1.3x.

Dragon's Maw.desc: Powers up the Pokémon's Dragon-type moves.
Dragon's Maw.accurate: Boosts the offensive stat used for Dragon-type attacks to 1.5x.

Chilling Neigh.desc: Boosts the Pokémon's Attack stat after knocking out a Pokémon.
Chilling Neigh.accurate: Raises Attack by 1 stage after attacking and KOing another Pokémon.

Grim Neigh.desc: Boosts the Pokémon's Sp. Atk stat after knocking out a Pokémon.
Grim Neigh.accurate: Raises Sp. Atk by 1 stage after attacking and KOing another Pokémon.

Lingering Aroma.desc: Contact with the Pokémon changes the attacker's Ability to Lingering Aroma.
Lingering Aroma.accurate: Changes the attackers Ability to Lingering Aroma when it makes contact.

Well-Baked Body.desc: This Pokémon takes no damage from Fire-type moves and its Defense is sharply boosted if hit by one.
Well-Baked Body.accurate: Grants immunity to Fire moves and raises Defense by 2 stages when hit by one.

Seed Sower.desc: Turns the ground into Grassy Terrain when the Pokémon is hit by an attack.
Seed Sower.accurate: Starts Grassy Terrain after being hit by an attack.

Purifying Salt.desc: The Pokémon's pure salt protects it from status conditions and halves the damage taken from Ghost-type moves.
Purifying Salt.accurate: Prevents status conditions and causes Ghost-type damage against it to use half the usual offensive stat.

Electromorphosis.desc: The Pokémon becomes charged when it takes damage, boosting the power of the next Electric-type move it uses.
Electromorphosis.accurate: Gains the Charge effect after taking a hit from an attack.

Wind Power.desc: The Pokémon becomes charged when it is hit by a wind move, boosting the power of the next Electric-type move it uses.
Wind Power.accurate: Gains the Charge effect when hit by a wind move or when Tailwind begins.

Wind Rider.desc: Boosts the Pokémon's Attack stat if Tailwind takes effect or if the Pokémon is hit by a wind move. The Pokémon also takes no damage from wind moves.
Wind Rider.accurate: Grants immunity to wind moves and raises Attack by 1 stage when hit by one or when Tailwind begins.

Mycelium Might.desc: The Pokémon will always act more slowly when using status moves, but these moves will be able to ignore abilities.
Mycelium Might.accurate: Causes status moves to move last in their priority bracket and makes them ignore Abilities.

Anger Shell.desc: When the Pokémon's HP drops to half or less, the Pokémon gets angry. This lowers its Defense and Sp. Def stats but boosts its Attack, Sp. Atk, and Speed stats.
Anger Shell.accurate: At 1/2 max HP or less, raises Attack, Sp. Atk, and Speed by 1 stage, and lowers Defense and Sp. Def by 1 stage.

Opportunist.desc: If an opponent's stat is boosted, the Pokémon seizes the opportunity to boost the same stat for itself.
Opportunist.accurate: Copies the effect whenever an opposing Pokémon raises one of its stat stages.

Zero to Hero.desc: The Pokémon transforms into its Hero Form when it switches out of battle.
Zero to Hero.accurate: If the user is Palafin in Zero Form, switching out changes it to Hero Form.

Earth Eater.desc: If hit by a Ground-type move, the Pokémon has its HP restored instead of taking damage.
Earth Eater.accurate: Grants immunity to Ground moves and restores 1/4 max HP when hit by one.

Toxic Debris.desc: Scatters poison spikes at the feet of the opposing team when the Pokémon is hit by a physical attack.
Toxic Debris.accurate: Sets Toxic Spikes on the opposing side when hit by a physical attack.

Commander.desc: When the Pokémon enters battle, it goes inside the mouth of an ally Dondozo if one is on the field.
Commander.accurate: If its ally is Dondozo, this Pokémon cannot act or be hit and raises all of Dondozos stats by 2 stages.

Cud Chew.desc: When the Pokémon eats a Berry, it will eat that Berry one more time at the end of the next turn.
Cud Chew.accurate: After eating a Berry, causes it to be eaten again at the end of the next turn.

Protosynthesis.desc: Boosts the Pokémon's most proficient stat in harsh sunlight or if the Pokémon is holding Booster Energy.
Protosynthesis.accurate: While Sunny Day is active or Booster Energy has been used, boosts the highest stat to 1.3x, or to 1.5x if that stat is Speed.

Quark Drive.desc: Boosts the Pokémon's most proficient stat on Electric Terrain or if the Pokémon is holding Booster Energy.
Quark Drive.accurate: While Electric Terrain is active or Booster Energy has been used, boosts the highest stat to 1.3x, or to 1.5x if that stat is Speed.

Thermal Exchange.desc: Boosts the Attack stat when the Pokémon is hit by a Fire-type move. The Pokémon also cannot be burned.
Thermal Exchange.accurate: Prevents burns and raises Attack by 1 stage after taking damage from a Fire move.

Good as Gold.desc: A body of pure, solid gold gives the Pokémon full immunity to other Pokémon's status moves.

Tablets of Ruin.desc: The power of the Pokémon's ruinous wooden tablets lowers the Attack stats of all Pokémon except itself.
Tablets of Ruin.accurate: While active, multiplies the Attack of Pokémon without this Ability by 0.75.

Sword of Ruin.desc: The power of the Pokémon's ruinous sword lowers the Defense stats of all Pokémon except itself.
Sword of Ruin.accurate: While active, multiplies the Defense of Pokémon without this Ability by 0.75.

Vessel of Ruin.desc: The power of the Pokémon's ruinous vessel lowers the Sp. Atk stats of all Pokémon except itself.
Vessel of Ruin.accurate: While active, multiplies the Sp. Atk of Pokémon without this Ability by 0.75.

Beads of Ruin.desc: The power of the Pokémon's ruinous beads lowers the Sp. Def stats of all Pokémon except itself.
Beads of Ruin.accurate: While active, multiplies the Sp. Def of Pokémon without this Ability by 0.75.

Orichalcum Pulse.desc: Turns the sunlight harsh when the Pokémon enters a battle. The ancient pulse thrumming through the Pokémon also boosts its Attack stat in harsh sunlight.
Orichalcum Pulse.accurate: Summons Sunny Day on switch-in. During Sunny Day, boosts Attack to 1.3333x.

Hadron Engine.desc: Turns the ground into Electric Terrain when the Pokémon enters a battle. The futuristic engine within the Pokémon also boosts its Sp. Atk stat on Electric Terrain.
Hadron Engine.accurate: Summons Electric Terrain on switch-in. During Electric Terrain, boosts Sp. Atk to 1.3333x.

Supersweet Syrup.desc: The sweet aroma of this Pokémon's syrup lowers the evasiveness of surrounding Pokémon.
Supersweet Syrup.accurate: Lowers the evasiveness of opponents by 1 stage on switch-in. Activates once per battle.

Hospitality.desc: The Pokémon's arrival in battle triggers a wave of healing, restoring a bit of its ally's HP.
Hospitality.accurate: Restores 1/4 of an allies maximum HP, rounded down, on switch-in.

Toxic Chain.desc: May badly poison a target when the Pokémon lands a hit.
Toxic Chain.accurate: Gives attacks a 30% chance to badly poison.

Tera Shift.desc: Changes the Pokémon's type to match the Tera type when it Terastallizes.
Tera Shift.accurate: If the user is Terapagos, it transforms into its Terastal Form on entry.

Poison Puppeteer.desc: Can manipulate poison, allowing it to poison any opposing Pokémon in the battle.
Poison Puppeteer.accurate: Pecharunt only. If it poisons a target, that target also becomes confused.

As One.desc: Combines the effects of the Unnerve Ability and another Ability.
As One.accurate: Combines Unnerve with either Chilling Neigh for Glastrier or Grim Neigh for Spectrier.

Mind's Eye.desc: The Pokémon can see everything that happens in the battlefield, allowing it to anticipate and dodge attacks.
Mind's Eye.accurate: Fighting- and Normal-type moves hit Ghost-type targets, prevents accuracy from being lowered, and ignores evasiveness.

Embody Aspect.desc: Changes the Pokémon's form depending on its surroundings.
Embody Aspect.accurate: On entry, raises one stat by 1 stage based on Ogerpon's form, with Defense for Cornerstone, Attack for Hearthflame, Speed for Teal, and Sp. Def for Wellspring.

Tera Shell.desc: Provides the Pokémon with a protective shield when it Terastallizes, reducing damage taken.
Tera Shell.accurate: While at full HP, attacks taken have 0.5x effectiveness unless the user is naturally immune.

Teraform Zero.desc: Allows the Pokémon to change its type freely when it Terastallizes.
Teraform Zero.accurate: Terastallizing ends the effects of weather and terrain. Activates once per battle.

Curious Medicine.desc: When the Pokémon enters the battlefield, it resets the stat changes of its allies.
Curious Medicine.accurate: Resets allies stat stages to 0 on switch-in.

Guard Dog.desc: Boosts the Pokémon's Attack stat if intimidated. Moves and items that would force the Pokémon to switch out also fail to work.
Guard Dog.accurate: Grants immunity to Intimidate, raises Attack by 1 stage when Intimidated, and prevents being forced to switch out.

Piercing Drill.desc: When the Pokémon uses contact moves, it can hit even targets that are protecting themselves, dealing 1/4 of the damage that the move would otherwise deal. Everything aside from the target's protective effects is still triggered.
Piercing Drill.accurate: Contact moves hit through protection moves, dealing 25% of the original damage. Other effects still trigger normally.

Rocky Payload.accurate: Boosts the offensive stat used for Rock-type attacks to 1.5x.

Costar.desc: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it copies an ally's stat changes.
Costar.accurate: Copies all of an allies stat stage changes on switch-in.

Supreme Overlord.desc: The Pokémon's stats are boosted if any ally Pokémon have already been defeated in the same battle.
Supreme Overlord.accurate: Boosts move power by 10% for each fainted ally, up to 5 allies.

Armor Tail.desc: Priority moves used by opposing Pokémon targeting this Pokémon or its allies are prevented from having an effect.
Armor Tail.accurate: Protects the user and its allies from opposing priority moves.

Mega Sol.desc: Moves used by the Pokémon act as if harsh sunlight is in effect.
Mega Sol.accurate: Makes moves behave as if Sunny Day were in effect, even when it is not.

Dragonize.desc: Normal-type moves become Dragon-type moves and their power is boosted by 1.2x.
Dragonize.accurate: Changes Normal-type moves to Dragon type and boosts their power to 1.2x.

Spicy Spray.desc: When the Pokémon takes damage from a move, it burns the attacker.
Spicy Spray.accurate: Burns the attacker when hit by a damaging move.

Eelevate.desc: The Pokémon floats off the ground, making it immune to Ground-type moves and entry hazards. When it knocks out a target, its highest stat is boosted.
Eelevate.accurate: Grants immunity to Ground-type moves, Spikes, Toxic Spikes, and Sticky Web. When the user knocks out a target with an attack, raises its highest stat by 1 stage.

Fire Mane.desc: Powers up the Pokémon's Fire-type moves.
